notes.title: Languages and Achievements Update
notes.notes:
In this update, subtitles have been added in Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, and Russian, and we've incorporated achievements. 

Thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: Update Patch 0.1
notes.notes: Improvements incoming! This patch fixes reported bugs, optimizes the experience, and adjusts anomalies for an even more unsettling immersion. Thanks for your continued support!
